name: Wasatch County, UT
findings: Wasatch County has 90 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wasatch County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
54% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Wasatch County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Wasatch County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 1 religious organization here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?
